text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Mean quantile score of GK and KEZ at D+1 on the cold-snap days of the scored winter at each substation. Every substation has under 15 such days, so no interval is given. Rule: a November to March day colder than the 10th percentile of such days from 2019-09 to 2024-06.'
text.tspan: Mean quantile score of GK and KEZ at D+1 on the cold-snap days of the scored winter at each substation. Every
substation has under 15 such days, so no interval is given. Rule: a November to March day colder than the 10th
percentile of such days from 2019-09 to 2024-06.
